import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_26/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_26/training_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation: JOIN on 'city' column as per operation_history
# Source0 columns: ['city', 'date', 'fare', 'ride_id']
# Source1 columns: ['city', 'driver_count', 'type']
# Target schema: ['city': string, 'driver_count': integer, 'type': string, 'date': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': integer]

# Perform inner join on 'city'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='city', how='inner')

# Reorder columns to match target schema
df_result = df_joined[['city', 'driver_count', 'type', 'date', 'fare', 'ride_id']]

# Ensure correct data types as per target schema
df_result['city'] = df_result['city'].astype(str)
df_result['driver_count'] = df_result['driver_count'].astype(int)
df_result['type'] = df_result['type'].astype(str)
df_result['date'] = df_result['date'].astype(str)
df_result['fare'] = df_result['fare'].astype(float)
df_result['ride_id'] = df_result['ride_id'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_26/target_multisource.csv"
df_result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
